beneficiaryAdministration:
HOW TO SUBMIT A GRANT APPLICATION?

  1. Complete and submit your application using the online application form. Log in at https://www.palyazat.gov.hu via the "Single sign-on Interface Login" button to access the e-Government (EPTK) system.

A user manual illustrating the use of the Unified Institutional System Interface is available at https://help.fair.gov.hu/node/427.

HOW ARE SUBMITTED GRANT APPLICATIONS EVALUATED?

  1. continuously check the eligibility of applications received in each phase according to the eligibility criteria specified in the call.
  2. submit eligible applications for content evaluation on an ongoing basis.
  3. make grant decision in each phase in order of the scores achieved during the evaluation.

Applicants are advised to monitor announcements and system messages. Notifications about budget monitoring are sent only to businesses that have started completing their grant application.
description:
WHO CAN SUBMIT A GRANT APPLICATION?

Micro, small and medium-sized enterprises may submit grant applications for the call if they:

  1. have at least three closed financial years (each supported by financial statements and covering full 365-day period of operation as a pre-company is not included);
  2. operate in the sectors listed in Annexes 2 or 3 of the Cybersecurity Act

WHAT ACTIVITIES ARE ELIGIBLE FOR SUPPORT?

  1. Acquisition of new equipment and intangible assets resulting in the enhancement of cyber resilience
  2. Centralised endpoint protection solutions (traditional antivirus);
  3. Advanced endpoint protection and incident detection solutions (EDR/XDR);
  4. Perimeter protection solutions (firewall, Web Application Firewall, proxy, VPN gateway);
title: Deploying The Network of National Coordination Centres with Member States
callTitle: Enhancing the Cybersecurity Capabilities of the Domestic SME Sector (SSNS-NCC-HU-FSTP-2026)
furtherInformation:
The purpose of this call for proposals is to enhance the cybersecurity resilience and risk management capabilities of the domestic SME sector, thereby contributing to the objectives of the European Cybersecurity Industrial, Technology and Research Competence Centre (hereinafter: ECCC) as set out in the Digital Europe Cybersecurity 2025-2027 Work Programme.

Under this call for proposals:

  1. Micro, small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) may submit grant applications without territorial restrictions;
  2. Applications must comply with the limitations specified in the call;
  3. Eligible applicants are those operating in the sectors listed in Annexes 2 or 3 of Act LXIX of 2024 on Cyber Security in Hungary.

Call for proposals

  1. Managing authority: NCC-HU;
  2. Funding source: Digital Europe Programme and the Hungarian State budget, through NCC-HU call for proposals DIGITAL-ECCC-2024-DEPLOY-NCC-06;

GreenChips-EDU Scholarship

1. Purpose of the call


The GreenChips-EDU Project was launched in 2023 with the aim of supporting talents in sustainable semiconductor technologies across Europe. The project seeks to educate students and researchers, equipping them with knowledge that will contribute to eco-friendly chip design, energy-efficient manufacturing, and materials innovation for the future of the EU.

As part of this initiative, TU Graz is pleased to announce a call for applications for scholarships supporting Master’s students enrolled or planning to enroll in the relevant study programmes at TU Graz:

  1. Electrical and Electronics Engineering
  2. Information and Computer Engineering
  3. Biomedical Engineering

The scholarship is intended to provide financial support to students participating in academia-industry collaborations through mobility programmes
